subject: english
question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.

A person in charge of the old people's home or a hostel
solution:
The correct answer is: **Warden**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Warden"** means a person in charge of a particular place or thing, such as an old people's home or a hostel. (प्रबंधक)

 
 
• **Example: **The **warden **of the hostel ensured that all the residents were safe and comfortable.
 
 
 
• Hence, the correct answer is Warden.

**​**Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Watchman** (चौकीदार): A person employed to guard a building or premises.

 
 
• **Example:** The **watchman **made his rounds every hour to ensure the building was secure.
 
 
 
• **Guard** (रक्षक): A person who protects a place or person.
 
 
• **Example:** The **guard **stood at the entrance, checking everyone's ID.
 
 
 
• **Warder** (कारागार का अधिकारी): A person in charge of a prison or the prisoners.
 
 
• **Example:** The **warder **ensured that all the inmates followed the prison rules.
